utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, after school pickup works for me. I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, see you then! I'll be bringing my old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: An old toaster? Huh, guess everything's fair game. See you after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, I almost forgot—the repair drive has been moved to Sunday instead of Saturday, same time and place at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sunday? That works better for me—I can coordinate with the school pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, so glad it fits your schedule! We'll see you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Repair drive? I'm sorry, I don't recall... could you remind me what that's about?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, it's a community event where we fix up donated items. I'm helping sort donations this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive! That sounds familiar. I've got an old toaster that might be worth bringing. What time does it start on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Noah, you going to the repair drive this weekend? I know a few people from the book club who'd love to help out if you're interested.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh hey Jules, yeah I think I'm planning on it. Saturday morning at the community center, right? I could use a refresher on the exact times though.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, Saturday at 9 AM at the community center. I can also rally some help from the book club if you'd like.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Ira, are you thinking of coming to the repair drive this Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, this Saturday? I heard something about it at the store but didn't know the time. I might stop by.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great! It starts at 10 a.m., and we'll have coffee and pastries too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Leo! We're organizing a neighborhood repair drive this weekend. Can I count on you to help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, I'll mention it to a few people.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's great, Leo! Maybe you can grab some flyers from me later to hand out too?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Uli, sorry I'm late—any update on the repair drive schedule?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think they're still setting up, but Hana mentioned she'd add my chair to the list.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh good, so they're already taking items? Then maybe we should head over and see if they need hands.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Nell, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend at the community center? They're fixing broken appliances for free!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I heard about it—Saturday from 10 to 4 at the community center! I'm thinking of bringing my broken toaster. Are you planning to go?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely! I'm planning to volunteer there all day. It's a great way to help the neighborhood and learn a thing or two about fixing stuff.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, let's check the inventory now on our phones.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great idea, I've got the list of tools right here on my phone too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Let's see what you've got there, Gus. Can you share that list so we can compare?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: So, have we got the exact times for the repair drive yet? I need to plan my day around it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'm not sure yet, Eli. Let me check with Jules to confirm the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks for checking, Hana. I just hope we get those times soon so I can mark my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks for explaining, Mara. So it's about fixing things to reduce waste. I'll be there Saturday morning to help with the flyers, Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Rey! See you Saturday morning—we'll make a great team!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'm looking forward to it. Do you know what kinds of tools we'll have available?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Kira, do you know where we're meeting for the repair drive? I've been mapping out the park equipment locations and want to make sure I have the right spot.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hold on, are we sure we have the right parts for that drive? I don't want to waste time if it's just going to be a bust.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Rosa said we're meeting at the community center on Saturday from 10 to 4. I'll check with her about the parts list to make sure we're set.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Vik, I've been hearing about this repair drive. What's it all about?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It's a community event where folks bring broken items to get fixed together. I'm still waiting on the exact times from the organizers.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds great. I'm curious what kinds of things people usually bring to fix.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I heard about the repair drive. Saturday morning at the center, right?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, Saturday morning? I need to double-check that myself.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Alright, let me know if it changes. I'll probably just show up anyway.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I still think we're missing something. Double-checking inventory won't help if the parts aren't there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Huh, inventory? Wait, are we still on for Saturday? I thought something changed...

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Saturday? Let's not get sidetracked. If we don't have the right parts, no amount of inventory checking will save us.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, let's open the inventory app and sort by the categories we need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Before we sort, let me confirm—are we still meeting at the community center on Saturday? I need to finalize my map.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, Saturday at the community center is confirmed. Let's focus on the inventory first, though.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Sam, have you heard anything about the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I'm actually helping sort through donations this Saturday. Want to join?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, I'd love to help! What time on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Rosa, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? I'm putting up flyers on main street—want to help?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, there's been a change! It's now on Sunday at the community center, same time. I can help with flyers after we update them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, thanks for letting me know! Let's meet up to update the flyers before putting them up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Quinn, are you still interested in joining the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely! I've been telling everyone about it. Are you coming too?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I'll be there. I'm helping coordinate the volunteers, so I'll be around all day.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Gus, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? It's at the community center from 10 to 4. They'll fix broken stuff like appliances or clothes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I heard about it! I've been gathering some tools to bring over. Need any particular ones?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm not sure exactly which ones, but Rosa might know—she's the one organizing it. Want me to ask her?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Eli, are you planning to join the repair drive this weekend? I've been rallying some folks and could use your help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'd like to help, Jules, but I still need the exact times and whether there's a sign-up sheet. I can't commit without knowing the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can get you the schedule from Hana, the main organizer. Let me check with her and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Leo, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? They're fixing old appliances for free at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'm organizing it. Need you to help sort tools on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, awesome! I'd love to help sort tools. What time should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, so we'll all meet after pickup today at the usual spot?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Wait, is today the repair drive? I thought it was on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: No, the drive is Saturday. Today we're just meeting to plan the schedule after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Mina, don't forget the repair drive this Saturday at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I remember, but do you know if we have extra cables and a power supply? I was just about to check the online inventory.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I think we have some from last time, but let's check the bin in the garage.
